test_numpy_array_attributes: test pybind11 numpy array bindings for ndim, shape, strides, size, itemsize, nbytes, writeable, and owndata attributes
test_numpy_array_index_offset: test pybind11 numpy array index_at and offset_at functions to get flat index and byte offset for given multi-dimensional indices
test_numpy_array_data_access: test pybind11 numpy array data and data_t functions to read raw array data starting from specified indices
test_numpy_array_mutation: test pybind11 numpy array mutate_data and mutate_at_t functions to modify array elements in place from C++ bindings
test_numpy_array_reshape_resize: test pybind11 numpy array reshape and resize operations including reference counting checks and ownership validation
